blocks.content: The single OS seam (cross-platform prep): run_command's shell invocation (zsh on macOS, bash on Linux, cmd /d /s /c on Windows), descendant-safe process-tree kills (POSIX process groups vs Windows taskkill /T /F), best-effort terminal opening (Terminal / start cmd / x-terminal-emulator family), git/tar binary lookup (/usr/bin defaults on macOS, PATH elsewhere — Windows 10+ ships bsdtar), the per-platform data-root bootstrap file location, and childEnv() — the minimal allowlist environment (PATH/HOME/SHELL/locale/tmp; no inherited cloud or CI tokens) handed to run_command and MCP/plugin spawns (2026-10 hardening). Everything OS-specific funnels here so platform differences live in exactly one module plus electron-builder.yml.
The two seams that actually behave differently per OS.
